entities.name: Minamoto no Noriyori
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Minamoto no Noriyori  was a Japanese samurai lord of the late Heian period and early Kamakura period, who fought alongside his brothers Minamoto no Yoritomo and Minamoto no Yoshitsune at a number of battles of the Genpei War. He was the sixth son of Minamoto no Yoshitomo.
